test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option which best completes the sentence.

When her daughter didn't come home on the last bus with the other girls, Mrs Mehta was ____, she was terrified that something dreadful had happened to her.

options.text: at the drop of a hat

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **at her wits' end**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"at her wits' end"** refers to being in a state of extreme worry or distress, where one feels helpless and unable to find a solution to a problem. (हद तक चिंतित होना)
 
 
• **Example:** After hours of trying to fix the computer, he was at his wits' end and called a technician.
 
 
• In the context of the sentence, Mrs. Mehta was extremely worried and terrified because her daughter didn’t come home, indicating she was "at her wits' end". (हद तक चिंतित)
 
 
• **Example:** When her son didn’t return home after school, she was at her wits' end.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. at her wits' end**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: at the last straw** (अंतिम बिंदु): Refers to the final act or event that causes a person to lose patience or composure.
 
 
• **Example:** The repeated delays were the last straw for the passengers, who started protesting.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: at sixes and sevens** (अव्यवस्थित): Refers to a state of confusion or disorder.
 
 
• **Example:** After the sudden resignation of the manager, the office was at sixes and sevens for weeks.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: at the drop of a hat** (बिना सोचे समझे): Refers to doing something immediately or without hesitation.
 
 
• **Example:** She is always ready to help others at the drop of a hat.
 
 

33:Tb25,

The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Blaming the wrong person**.
